PASS - security review, C34 round 1 of 2.
PR: #266
Head: 890515121f3d8f38cc96947847e7178ce42e1cc9

No security vulnerabilities found in the six changed files.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None found in scope | - |

Security evidence:

1. Counter keys are server-controlled, not retained client input.
   crates/daemon/src/http/route_counts.rs:27-47,110-179 restrict methods to
   seven constants plus OTHER and use one (unmatched) bucket.
   route_counts.rs:188-246 uses Axum MatchedPath rather than the raw URI.
   Query values become a fixed bitmask; rendered names use six constant
   parameter names and the literal scope=local. Raw paths, query values,
   tokens, seat IDs and job IDs do not become request-counter keys.

2. Both key cardinality and retained key bytes are bounded.
   crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:266-399 supplies 62 static route templates.
   route_counts.rs:63-85,110-179 bounds the route snapshot to 497 keys
   (62 templates x 8 method buckets, plus unmatched); :45-47,188-220 uses
   128 fixed query-shape slots. Long methods collapse to OTHER and unknown
   paths to unmatched. Request data cannot add retained labels or key bytes.

3. Authentication is unchanged.
   crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:705,796-843 retains require_bearer for
   health and adds job-token routes separately before the outer counting
   layer. mod.rs:480-486,518-555 preserves the peer-key allowlist, which
   excludes health. route_counts.rs:224-246 returns next.run's response
   unchanged. http/background.rs:422-472 and background.rs:631-647 retain
   job-token verification. lib.rs:1231-1261 serves the same shared router
   on both listeners. Delegated source inspection also checked the pinned
   Axum implementation for template provenance and fallback layering.

Validation:

- just pr-freeze 266: FINAL, exact head matched ls-remote and gh, main
  CLEAN, non-draft, all five latest checks passed, worktree clean.
- CI run 44489032862 at this exact head: successful; rust-lint,
  rust-test, check (22), check (24) all successful. The delivers run
  44489032748 also succeeded.
- Successful rust-test job 135439657640 reports 2579 passed, 6 skipped.
  Its upload log identifies JUnit artifact 14512171702; that exact
  artifact independently confirms these three regressions passed:
  counts_by_route_method_and_outcome_and_leaves_unrequested_routes_out;
  seats_reads_are_counted_by_query_shape_and_unknown_parameters_add_no_keys;
  ping_counts_requests_by_route_and_seats_reads_by_query_shape.
- Delegated review checked the full six-file diff, relevant auth,
  background, listener and Axum source, and git diff --check.
- No local builds, Cargo commands, tests, typechecks, live-daemon probes
  or harness checks were run, as instructed. The author's mutation
  receipts were not independently rerun. Security behavior outside the
  CI regressions is source-reviewed, not a local dynamic reproduction.

Cost observation for the separate performance review:

No new periodic loop, poll, timer, process launch, per-request log or
store write. Work is request-driven; snapshots scale with the fixed
route/method/query vocabulary, not seat count. Source inspection finds
a mutex/map lookup on matched request accounting
(route_counts.rs:110-139), so this is not an atomic-only hot path.
This security PASS does not certify live CPU cost or performance approval.

Harness feedback, not a PR finding:

magicWand: a no-build review-readiness command that verifies the checkout's
exact head against successful CI. Difficulty: generic boot/checks recipes
build, conflicting with read-only fleet reviews. This repeats the existing
dependency-free review-readiness lesson and was captured as MW-001.
Suggested encoding: a scoped read-only CI/finality receipt, without
dependency installation, shared configuration changes or Cargo execution.
